parts.text: In this experiment, you will compare the rates of temperature increase of two different coloured surfaces. You are provided with two thermometers, one of which has a piece of white card attached to its bulb, and one of which has a piece of black card attached to its bulb. Both pieces of card are identical, except for the colour of their surfaces. The thermometers have been clamped so that the bulb of each thermometer is level with the filament of a lamp. The lamp is switched off. Figure 2.1 shows the apparatus. Figure 2.1
